exact_statement: For independent r-bit point indicators A_i, p=2^-r, b=1-p, l=4^r, alternating constants m_i=(-1)^(l-i), E=product_i(1-A_i), K=sum_i m_i A_i product_(h<i)(1-A_h), and a fresh fair sign Z, the actual Boolean function F=K+EZ has Inf_Z=b^l, original fine U=R=0, and [H(F)-(H(K+E)+H(K-E))/2]/Inf_Z tending to pi^2/(2 ln 2) as r tends to infinity; its erasure ratio tends to pi/ln2. The r=7,l=2048 actual finite witness on14337 bits has complete entropy decrement/query-influence in(7.119,7.120), certified by rational logarithm intervals. Therefore a uniform local private-priority controller payment in this same fine ledger needs coefficient at least pi^2/(2ln2); fixed additive slack cannot lower that coefficient for tensor-closed additive per-factor ledger rules. The actual last-frequency log moment b(1-b^l)(-ln b)/p tends to1 nat; its inverse-tail first moment is exactly1+lp, and actual nonempty coherent amplitudes have first absolute moment at least lp. Full FEI and optimality of an upper controller coefficient are not asserted.
